versions.localizedDescription:
NEW

Remote AltServer Onboarding
• New in-app guide to easily set up on-device sideloading
• Get started in seconds with easy to follow instructions
• Tap “Set-Up Remote AltServer” in settings

On-Device Pairing (iOS 27+)
• Install and sideload apps without ever touching a computer!
• Set up remote AltServer without manually pairing with AltServer

IMPROVED
• Improved remote AltServer reliability
• No longer need to restart app after pairing with remote AltServer
• Ignores “Couldn’t reach remote AltServer” error when refreshing apps in background without VPN

FIXED
• Fixed crash when refreshing multiple apps with local AltServer
